## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `go test -race ./...` passes
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] Native target build passes
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible changes
- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain only synthetic, non-sensitive data
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior and compatibility risks are explained
